result.instructions: Tools for Countly, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many users and sessions did my app have in the last 30 days?"; "Which countries bring the most users to my iOS app this week?"; "Show the top app versions and platforms for my Android app.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Countly data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run countly_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run countly_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run countly_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. countly_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: countly_get_current_user
tools.title: Current Countly user
tools.description: Show the Countly dashboard user this API key belongs to: name, username, whether it is a global admin, and its permissions. Use it first to check the connection. Countly: GET /o/users/me.

tools.name: countly_list_apps
tools.title: List apps
tools.description: List the apps this user can see, split into apps the user administers and apps the user can read. Each app has its ID, name, country and timezone. Countly: GET /o/apps/mine.

tools.name: countly_get_app
tools.title: Get app details
tools.description: Show one app's settings, owner, creation and last-data times, and its member lists. Needs app administrator rights for that app. Countly: GET /o/apps/details.

app_id.description: The app ID (24 hex characters). Get it from countly_list_apps.

tools.name: countly_get_dashboard
tools.title: Dashboard summary
tools.description: Summary cards for one app and period: total sessions, new users, total users, time spent and requests, each with its change against the previous period. Countly: GET /o/analytics/dashboard.

app_id.description: The app ID (24 hex characters). Get it from countly_list_apps.

period.description: Period, for example today, 7days, 30days, month or a custom range. Default 30days.

tools.name: countly_get_sessions
tools.title: Sessions over time
tools.description: Session timeline for one app and period: one row per day (or per month with bucket=monthly) with sessions, new users, total users, duration and events. Countly: GET /o/analytics/sessions.

app_id.description: The app ID (24 hex characters). Get it from countly_list_apps.

period.description: Period, for example today, 7days, 30days, month or a custom range. Default 30days.

bucket.description: Group the rows by day (default) or by month.

tools.name: countly_get_countries
tools.title: Users by country
tools.description: Top countries for one app in fixed blocks: today, the last 7 days and the last 30 days, each with users, new users and sessions. Countly: GET /o/analytics/countries.

app_id.description: The app ID (24 hex characters). Get it from countly_list_apps.

tools.name: countly_get_metric
tools.title: Metric breakdown
tools.description: One breakdown list for one app and period, for example users by platform, device, screen resolution, carrier or app version. An unknown metric returns an empty list. Countly: GET /o/analytics/metric.

app_id.description: The app ID (24 hex characters). Get it from countly_list_apps.

metric.description: Metric key, for example countries, platforms, resolutions, carriers, devices or app_versions.

period.description: Period, for example today, 7days, 30days, month or a custom range. Default 30days.

tools.name: countly_get_tops
tools.title: Top lists
tools.description: Top-ten lists for one app and period. Without metric it returns the built-in lists (platforms, versions, countries and more); with metric it returns that one list. Countly: GET /o/analytics/tops.

app_id.description: The app ID (24 hex characters). Get it from countly_list_apps.

period.description: Period, for example today, 7days, 30days, month or a custom range. Default 30days.

metric.description: One metric key, for example countries. Omit for the built-in lists.

tools.name: countly_get_loyalty
tools.title: User loyalty
tools.description: How often users return in one app and period: the share of users per session-count bucket. Countly: GET /o/analytics/loyalty.

app_id.description: The app ID (24 hex characters). Get it from countly_list_apps.

period.description: Period, for example today, 7days, 30days, month or a custom range. Default 30days.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Countly
prompts.description: What you can do with Countly here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: get_the_dashboard_summary_of_an_app
prompts.title: Get the dashboard summary of an app
prompts.description: List the apps you can read, with their IDs. Get the summary cards of one app for a period, with the change against the previous period.

prompts.name: track_sessions_and_new_users_over_time
prompts.title: Track sessions and new users over time
prompts.description: Get the session timeline of one app, with one row per day or per month. Each row has sessions, new users, total users and duration.

prompts.name: compare_countries_and_app_versions
prompts.title: Compare countries and app versions
prompts.description: Get the top countries of one app for today, the last 7 days and the last 30 days. Get one breakdown, such as users by platform or app version.

prompts.name: measure_how_often_users_come_back
prompts.title: Measure how often users come back
prompts.description: Get the share of users in each session-count bucket for one app and period. Use it to see how often users return.

prompts.name: check_the_access_of_the_api_key
prompts.title: Check the access of the API key
prompts.description: Read the dashboard user that the key belongs to, with its permissions. Get the settings of one app, when that user administers it.
